n7cc2fe58ac.headline: In first, Turkmenistan to supply Turkey directly with gas: What to know
n7cc2fe58ac.summary: Turkey's state pipeline operator BOTAS and Turkmenistan's Turkmengaz will begin gas flows from Turkmenistan to Turkey on March 1, the first direct supply of its kind.
n7cc2fe58ac.why: BOTAS manages Turkey's gas pipeline imports, so new supply sources affect Turkey's energy costs and reliance on imports.

source.name: AL-MONITOR: The Middle Eastʼs leading independent news source since 2012

sources.name: AL-MONITOR: The Middle Eastʼs leading independent news source since 2012

n6b4a636943.headline: Trump says Hamas should free all hostages by midday Saturday or ‘let hell break out’
n6b4a636943.summary: US President Donald Trump said on Monday that Hamas should release all hostages held by the militant group, warning that hell would break out if it did not comply by midday Saturday.
n6b4a636943.why: Conflict and hostage developments in Gaza affect Middle East risk premiums, regional energy supply perceptions and investor sentiment toward the region.

n876f954870.headline: Jumbo Cyprus sees 3 per cent increase in sales
n876f954870.summary: Greek retail chain Jumbo Group reported a 3% increase in January sales for its stores in Cyprus, according to company data, amid ongoing global logistics challenges.
n876f954870.why: Jumbo Group is a Greek toy and retail chain, and its regional sales trends indicate consumer demand in its markets.

na50d82e58f.headline: EU vows tough countermeasures to US steel and aluminium tariffs
na50d82e58f.summary: European Union chief Ursula von der Leyen said tariffs are taxes that are bad for business and worse for consumers, as the bloc vowed tough countermeasures against US steel and aluminium tariffs.
na50d82e58f.why: The EU is the largest trading bloc in the world, and steel and aluminium tariffs disrupt cross-border supply chains and export revenues for European manufacturers.

n9ada4c47d1.headline: Trump once again slaps taxes on foreign steel, aluminum, a move that proved costly in his first term
n9ada4c47d1.summary: President Donald Trump is hitting foreign steel and aluminum with a 25% tax, a move similar to one that proved costly during his first term.
n9ada4c47d1.why: Steel and aluminium are core industrial inputs, and tariffs on them affect manufacturers, metals producers and trading partners across the global supply chain.
n9ada4c47d1.why_moved: The input reports a new 25% tax on foreign steel and aluminum, a trade measure that affects metal prices and import costs.

n813328da26.headline: DomRep to buy back 2026 notes
n813328da26.summary: The Dominican Republic plans to repurchase global bonds denominated in US dollars and local currency, according to LatinFinance.
n813328da26.why: Sovereign bond buybacks let governments manage debt maturities and refinancing risk, which affects investor sentiment toward emerging market debt.

nb477d12603.headline: Somalia Finance Minister to Asharq Al-Awsat: We Settled $4.5 Bln in Debt with Saudi Support
nb477d12603.summary: Somalia's Finance Minister said the country has settled around $4.5 billion in debt under the IMF-led Heavily Indebted Poor Countries initiative, with Saudi support.
nb477d12603.why: The HIPC initiative is an IMF and World Bank program that reduces debt for eligible poor countries. Clearing arrears can restore access to concessional financing and improve a sovereign's credit standing.

n842fa300da.headline: Beijing declines to confirm Trump's claim of call with Xi
n842fa300da.summary: Beijing declined to confirm a conversation between Trump and Xi Jinping after Trump said they had spoken, as concerns about a heightened trade war between the two largest economies mount.
n842fa300da.why: The US and China are the world's two largest economies, and their trade dispute affects global supply chains, tariffs and equity markets. Leader-level contact is watched as a sign of possible de-escalation.
n842fa300da.why_moved: Growing concerns about a heightened trade war between the US and China, and observers' focus on a possible Trump-Xi call as a sign of relief, are shaping sentiment.

n5da7ddf461.headline: EU Vows Tough Countermeasures to US Tariffs
n5da7ddf461.summary: European Commission chief Ursula von der Leyen said US tariffs on steel and aluminum will not go unanswered and will trigger tough countermeasures from the 27-nation bloc.
n5da7ddf461.why: The EU is a major trading bloc, and tariffs on steel and aluminum affect metal prices, exporters and supply chains on both sides of the Atlantic. Retaliation can widen into a broader trade dispute.
n5da7ddf461.why_moved: US tariffs on steel and aluminum prompted a vow of EU countermeasures, raising the risk of a wider trade dispute between the two economies.

n27bd9655ae.headline: Tariffs will “blow a hole” in the US auto industry, says Ford CEO
n27bd9655ae.summary: Ford's chief executive said tariffs will "blow a hole" in the US auto industry, speaking out against a Trump administration trade policy.
n27bd9655ae.why: Ford is a major US automaker whose costs and sales depend heavily on imported parts and vehicles, so tariff policy directly affects its margins.

n92fffcff2e.headline: Subscriptions in the Fidelis offering exceeded 250 million euros
n92fffcff2e.summary: Subscriptions in the Fidelis bond offering exceeded 250 million euros, with annual interest rates of 7.95% to 6.95% on lei tranches and 4% to 6.25% on euro tranches. The securities will be listed on the BVB on February 20.
n92fffcff2e.why: The Bucharest Stock Exchange (BVB) is Romania's main exchange, and corporate bond offerings there show local capital market depth and borrowing costs.

n4ea7359f2f.headline: Trump tariffs an early challenge for new ambassador Mandelson
n4ea7359f2f.summary: Lord Mandelson said the UK has to 'respect and understand' what drives the US president, as Trump tariffs present an early challenge for the new ambassador.
n4ea7359f2f.why: US tariffs on UK goods affect trade flows and the outlook for British exporters, making UK-US trade relations a key macro issue for investors.

nfe158cca76.headline: Australia open to acquiring collapsed regional airline Rex
nfe158cca76.summary: The Australian government said it was open to acquiring collapsed airline Regional Express Holdings to ensure its regional services continue, which would be a first.
nfe158cca76.why: Rex is a regional carrier, and government ownership would shape regional aviation services and the competitive landscape in Australian air travel.

nec23f43ac1.headline: Cyprus Business Now: BoC upgrade, Logicom deal, trade deficit, airport traffic
nec23f43ac1.summary: S&P Global Ratings raised Bank of Cyprus's long-term issuer credit rating to BBB- from BB+. The agency cited reduced reliance on less stable non-resident deposits across Cypriot banks.
nec23f43ac1.why: Bank of Cyprus is the island's largest listed lender, and its credit ratings affect its funding costs. Rating changes are closely followed by bondholders and equity investors.

n269982296d.headline: Sam Altman reiterates OpenAI ‘not for sale’ after Elon Musk-led bid
n269982296d.summary: OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman reiterated that the company is 'not for sale' following an Elon Musk-led bid. He made the remarks while attending the AI Action Summit in Paris.
n269982296d.why: OpenAI is a leading artificial intelligence developer whose ownership and governance affect the AI sector and its investors and partners.

nfa6499098e.headline: Easebuzz gets RBI authorisation to operate as online payment aggregator
nfa6499098e.summary: Easebuzz has secured final authorisation from the Reserve Bank of India to operate as an online payment aggregator. The platform serves over 200,000 businesses and processes an annual GTV of USD 30 billion.
nfa6499098e.why: Payment aggregators process online transactions for merchants, and RBI licensing sets the rules under which they operate in India's digital payments market.

n63aed8f3a1.headline: How the gutting of USAID is reverberating around the world: Worry, despair, praise
n63aed8f3a1.summary: Reactions to changes at USAID range from support, including from Mexico's president, to fears that lives will be lost as health care programmes are cut.
n63aed8f3a1.why: USAID is the US government agency that administers foreign aid. Changes to its funding affect global health programmes and the aid-dependent economies that rely on them.

n057c9201a3.headline: ArcelorMittal wants to move some activities from Europe to India
n057c9201a3.summary: ArcelorMittal announced it intends to move certain support services activities from Europe to India, according to AFP. The steel group is also present on the Romanian market.
n057c9201a3.why: ArcelorMittal is one of the world's largest steelmakers, and relocating back-office functions is a common cost-reduction step for multinational industrial groups.

n91b3b6da0a.headline: Power companies look at extending Huntly’s lifespan
n91b3b6da0a.summary: The big four New Zealand power companies are looking at ways of extending the life of the Rankine units at Huntly. The report comes from the NZ Herald.
n91b3b6da0a.why: Huntly is New Zealand's largest thermal power station, and its operating life affects electricity supply and security during dry periods.

na9bb2aa9d1.headline: 'I'm Not Going to Do That': Donald Trump Rambles On When Confronted About Promise to Reduce Grocery Prices on Day One, Later Says He 'Can’t Guarantee' Americans Won't Pay More
na9bb2aa9d1.summary: Asked about his promise to reduce grocery prices on day one, Donald Trump said he would not do that and later said he 'can't guarantee' Americans won't pay more.
na9bb2aa9d1.why: Grocery and consumer price inflation is a key input for US interest-rate expectations and consumer spending, which drive broad market sentiment.

ne1cf480721.headline: Ukraine's post-war recovery: financing, governance and reform strategies
ne1cf480721.summary: Mechanisms for Ukraine's post-war reconstruction need to be established while the war is ongoing, to support the country's future Euro-Atlantic integration.
ne1cf480721.why: Reconstruction financing for Ukraine involves government budgets, international aid and private capital, which shape long-term investment in the country.

n66634d6d6b.headline: President Mahama inaugurates taskforce to deliver on 120-Day social contract
n66634d6d6b.summary: President John Mahama inaugurated a 20-member taskforce to implement reforms in his 120-day Social Contract, including tax cuts and economic policies.
n66634d6d6b.why: Tax changes and economic reforms directly affect Ghana's fiscal position, business climate and investor confidence.

n6c7dd31711.headline: Swedish new builds without windows or kitchens
n6c7dd31711.summary: Sweden's National Board of Housing, Building and Planning will deregulate certain rules for new construction from July 1, 2025. The move comes amid rising prices and difficulty in the housing market.
n6c7dd31711.why: Building regulation changes affect construction costs, housing supply, and the outlook for property developers in Sweden.

n6bcf2374a2.headline: French wine exports weaken for second straight year
n6bcf2374a2.summary: Exports of French wine and spirits totalled A$27.9 billion in 2024, a four per cent decline from 2023. The figure marks a second consecutive year of weakening sales.
n6bcf2374a2.why: France is one of the world's largest wine producers and exporters, so shifts in its export value affect the global beverage trade and the agricultural sector.

nfe18fac7a5.headline: Commonwealth Bank posts $5.1 billion interim profit, beating estimates
nfe18fac7a5.summary: Commonwealth Bank reported a A$5.1 billion interim profit that beat estimates. It will pay a A$2.25 per share dividend, five per cent higher than last year, after a small rise in first-half earnings.
nfe18fac7a5.why: Commonwealth Bank is one of Australia's largest lenders and a major constituent of the ASX 200, so its results signal conditions in Australian banking.

n164bec69a7.headline: Iran loosens import restrictions on foreign cars and iPhones, trying to mask its economic woes
n164bec69a7.summary: Iran has loosened import restrictions on foreign cars and iPhones, with an additional allowance reported. The move comes as the cash-strapped government faces economic pressure.
n164bec69a7.why: Import rules shape domestic demand, currency pressure and the trade balance of an economy under sanctions.

nbd28b6db03.headline: Who is Asmita Patel, the Instagram ‘Options Queen’ banned by SEBI for unauthorized stock advice? |
nbd28b6db03.summary: India's market regulator SEBI has banned Asmita Patel, known as the 'Options Queen', for unregistered investment advice given through her trading school and social media.
nbd28b6db03.why: SEBI is India's securities regulator, and it enforces rules requiring registration for investment advice to protect market participants.

ne1b991afa0.headline: Sebi bars LS Industries from securities market for alleged stock manipulation - BusinessToday
ne1b991afa0.summary: SEBI has temporarily prohibited LS Industries Ltd, its promoters and key individuals from trading its shares and participating in the securities market over alleged stock price manipulation.
ne1b991afa0.why: SEBI is India's securities regulator, and trading bans on listed companies and insiders affect shareholders and market confidence.

n02c1aeffe3.headline: Trump raises steel tariffs, weighs Australia exemption
n02c1aeffe3.summary: US President Donald Trump has announced 25 per cent tariffs on all steel and aluminium imports. He is weighing an exemption for Australia.
n02c1aeffe3.why: Steel and aluminium tariffs raise input costs for manufacturers and can prompt retaliation that disrupts exporters. Metals producers in exporting countries are directly exposed to US trade barriers.
n02c1aeffe3.why_moved: A 25 per cent tariff on all steel and aluminium imports raises costs for US buyers and exporters of these metals, which markets reprice quickly.

n47876f3016.headline: Hiltzik: Trump's move to kill federal consumer watchdog will protect Big Business but cost consumers billions
n47876f3016.summary: Trump has moved to kill the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, a federal consumer watchdog. The move is described as one that will protect big business.
n47876f3016.why: The CFPB supervises consumer finance providers such as banks and lenders and writes rules for them. Changes to its authority affect compliance costs and regulatory risk for financial firms.

n1dae11e867.headline: Judicial, Anti-Corruption Reforms at forefront of Chief Justice Afridi-IMF delegation meeting
n1dae11e867.summary: An IMF delegation met Chief Justice Afridi in Islamabad, seeking details on Pakistan's judicial system and governance. Judicial and anti-corruption reforms were at the forefront of the meeting.
n1dae11e867.why: The International Monetary Fund lends to countries under conditional programmes, and governance and anti-corruption reforms are often conditions that affect investor confidence in borrowers like Pakistan.

n9d11c9f652.headline: Trump raises steel tariffs, weighs Australia exemption
n9d11c9f652.summary: US President Donald Trump announced 25 per cent tariffs on all steel and aluminium imports. Australia may be exempted from the measure, according to the report.
n9d11c9f652.why: Steel and aluminium tariffs raise input costs for manufacturers and can trigger retaliation, affecting global metals trade and exporters.
n9d11c9f652.why_moved: Broad 25% tariffs on steel and aluminium imports raise trade-war risk and input costs for exporters and manufacturers.

n8ddf0a5fc9.headline: Gold's record highs are more than just Trump froth:  Russell
n8ddf0a5fc9.summary: Gold's surge to a fresh record high is being fuelled by fears of an escalating global trade war instigated by US President Donald Trump, according to Russell.
n8ddf0a5fc9.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset that tends to attract demand when trade and geopolitical uncertainty rise.
n8ddf0a5fc9.why_moved: Fears of an escalating trade war are driving safe-haven demand for gold to a new record.

nc72e66f8a7.headline: Russia's 'shadow fleet' brings 'high risk' of oil spill
nc72e66f8a7.summary: Ageing and deficient tankers in Russia's shadow fleet are traffic shallow Baltic Sea waters, raising the risk of a major oil spill, experts told AFP. Hundreds of vessels reportedly evade Western sanctions.
nc72e66f8a7.why: Shadow fleet tankers operate outside standard insurance and sanctions frameworks, raising environmental, shipping and sanctions risks for oil trade.

n6c20baa9da.headline: Modi to inaugurate Global Investors Summit in Bhopal on Feb 24: MP Chief Minister Mohan Yadav
n6c20baa9da.summary: Prime Minister Modi will inaugurate the Invest Madhya Pradesh Global Investors Summit in Bhopal on February 24, with Amit Shah attending the closing on February 25.
n6c20baa9da.why: Investor summits signal state-level investment pipelines and policy priorities in India, a major emerging economy.

n05e1616690.headline: 'Dutton-proof': no more clean energy money for uranium
n05e1616690.summary: Parliament has passed an amendment ensuring clean energy incentives will not support uranium mining, a change that could also hinder future projects.
n05e1616690.why: Clean energy subsidies shape investment flows across the energy sector, and uranium is a key input for nuclear power.

n4878ae5091.headline: Donald Trump pauses US foreign bribery law; relief for Adani Group? | India News
n4878ae5091.summary: President Donald Trump signed an order pausing enforcement of the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act. The move could help the Adani Group, which was previously under scrutiny.
n4878ae5091.why: The Foreign Corrupt Practices Act governs bribery by US-listed firms and their foreign dealings, so enforcement changes affect compliance risk for multinationals.

n970da1623a.headline: NatWest cuts new business rates; Paragon lowers BTL pricing – round-up
n970da1623a.summary: NatWest reduced pricing across new business mortgages by as much as 36 basis points, effective from February 12. Paragon also lowered its buy-to-let pricing.
n970da1623a.why: NatWest is a major UK high-street bank and mortgage lender. Mortgage pricing changes influence borrowing costs for households and the housing market.

n32eb2422b7.headline: MSCI Equity Indexes February 2025 Index Review
n32eb2422b7.summary: MSCI announced the results of its February 2025 Index Review for the MSCI Equity Indexes, with all changes to be implemented from February 12, 2025.
n32eb2422b7.why: MSCI publishes global equity benchmarks that many institutional funds track, so constituent changes can drive passive fund rebalancing.

n8a38fe7ba2.headline: North American Morning Briefing :  Stock Futures Lower on Firm Tariffs Plan
n8a38fe7ba2.summary: Index futures slid on Tuesday after the U.S. outlined a concrete plan for foreign metals tariffs. Stocks had earlier shrugged off the tariff threat but looked set to fall.
n8a38fe7ba2.why: Tariffs on imported metals raise input costs for manufacturers and can disrupt global supply chains, which is why equity futures react quickly to trade-policy announcements.
n8a38fe7ba2.why_moved: Index futures fell after the U.S. outlined a concrete plan for foreign metals tariffs, after stocks had initially shrugged off the threat.

nfc349d99d0.headline: Freeland announces plan to cap grocery profits, expand competition
nfc349d99d0.summary: Liberal leadership candidate Chrystia Freeland proposed a plan to cap grocery profits and expand competition to lower food prices. The plan targets cost-of-living concerns.
nfc349d99d0.why: Grocery retail is a large, concentrated sector in Canada, so profit caps or competition rules would directly affect major grocers' margins.

n69b869de6c.headline: Trump's halt of US law banning business bribes abroad raises specter of a 'Wild West' of dealmaking
n69b869de6c.summary: President Trump has paused enforcement of a law banning companies from bribing foreign government officials. Critics warn the decision could upend a half-century of US policy under both parties.
n69b869de6c.why: The US Foreign Corrupt Practices Act governs how American companies and their overseas partners win contracts abroad. Changes to its enforcement affect legal risk for firms doing business internationally.

n062f368f2e.headline: Ursula von der Leyen: We are mobilizing euro200 billion for the development of artificial intelligence
n062f368f2e.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announced the InvestAI initiative at the Paris AI Action Summit, aiming to mobilise €200 billion in public and private funds for AI.
n062f368f2e.why: The European Commission sets EU-wide economic and industrial policy, and large public-private AI funding shapes demand for chips, data centers and AI services.

nb2155a97f1.headline: KSE-100 gains 1,632 points as buying persists
nb2155a97f1.summary: The KSE-100 index on the Pakistan Stock Exchange gained 1,632 points. Positive momentum persisted for a second consecutive session during the week.
nb2155a97f1.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, tracking the country's largest listed companies.

na1bde84797.headline: Pakistan Tanners Association concerned at DISCOs’ demand to increase security deposit
na1bde84797.summary: The Pakistan Tanners Association expressed deep concern over a proposal from power distribution companies to increase security deposits. The association's chairman, Hamid Arshad Zahur, raised the issue in Karachi.
na1bde84797.why: Electricity distribution companies, known as DISCOs, supply power to industrial users, and deposit requirements affect operating costs for exporters and manufacturers. Tanneries are an important part of Pakistan's leather export sector.

n21e6d74cc8.headline: PRL struggles in 1HFY25 amid refinery upgrade plans
n21e6d74cc8.summary: Pakistan Refinery Limited reported net sales of Rs168.88 billion for the first half of FY25, a year-on-year change the report describes as a struggle. The company is also planning a refinery upgrade.
n21e6d74cc8.why: Pakistan Refinery is a Karachi-listed oil refiner, and its sales and upgrade plans reflect fuel demand and refining economics in Pakistan.

nde3e0fc0e9.headline: Early sowing: a strategic step towards cotton revival
nde3e0fc0e9.summary: Pakistan's cotton sector has faced a significant downturn in recent years, and early sowing is being presented as a strategic step toward reviving the crop.
nde3e0fc0e9.why: Cotton is a key input for Pakistan's textile industry, which is a major export earner. Crop output affects both farm incomes and textile manufacturers' costs.

n57508234d2.headline: Tax breaks for homebuilding investors floated by Micheál Martin
n57508234d2.summary: Micheál Martin has floated tax breaks for investors in homebuilding. People Before Profit TD Paul Murphy called the proposal extremely concerning.
n57508234d2.why: Tax incentives for residential development influence housing supply and the investment case for property developers and construction firms.

n43aaaebe69.headline: Another Year, Another Tumble In Harley-Davidson Sales
n43aaaebe69.summary: Harley-Davidson's 2024 sales fell, reflecting ongoing challenges in the motorcycle market and consumer demand.
n43aaaebe69.why: Automotive and motorcycle sales data influence related sectors and investor sentiment in manufacturing stocks.

n7119eb7544.headline: Suzlon Energy, YES Bank, Waaree Energies, Tata Power, Vedanta share biz updates - BusinessToday
n7119eb7544.summary: Vedanta benefits from lower alumina prices, while YES Bank expects margin expansion from FY26, indicating sectoral trends.
n7119eb7544.why: Company performance updates influence investor sentiment and sector outlooks in India.

n508ca2ceaf.headline: Man dodges jail over $3.4m Malaysian kickback plan
n508ca2ceaf.summary: A man involved in false accounting related to a multimillion-dollar building sale to a Malaysian government-owned entity faces jail.
n508ca2ceaf.why: Corruption and fraud cases can impact investor confidence and the reputation of Malaysian real estate and government dealings.

n9e91213e38.headline: Wall Street takes Trump's latest tariff threats in stride, and indexes rise
n9e91213e38.summary: US stocks gained as Wall Street responded positively to President Trump’s tariff threats, with major indices rising.
n9e91213e38.why: Tariff policies influence trade, inflation, and corporate earnings, affecting market sentiment.

ncc1a45f84a.headline: Hamas says it will stop releasing Israeli hostages, throwing Gaza ceasefire into doubt
ncc1a45f84a.summary: Hamas has stopped releasing Israeli hostages, citing violations of the Gaza ceasefire agreement. Israeli military readiness has increased amid fears of a breakdown.
ncc1a45f84a.why: The ceasefire impacts regional stability and humanitarian aid efforts, influencing geopolitical risk premiums and investor sentiment in the Middle East.

n3a022a3cdd.headline: US$67 billion infrastructure gap in India hampers gas goals
n3a022a3cdd.summary: India's infrastructure shortfalls, including high gas prices and regulatory issues, hamper Prime Minister Modi's gas expansion plans.
n3a022a3cdd.why: Infrastructure development and energy policies are critical for India's economic growth and energy security.
